usedFor: Each new anny invoice is filed as a copy in Dropbox.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in anny, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Each invoice is saved to a chosen folder, with a choice to add, replace or update.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” needs a public file link, so the invoice trigger must supply a reachable URL.
